cases.sentence: Потому что ___ поднимется на народ и царство на царство.
cases.translation: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.
cases.explain: Народ is the subject of поднимется (will rise), so it stands in the nominative.

cases.sentence: Когда Иисус выходил из ___, один из учеников сказал ему, «Учитель, посмотри, какие камни, какие здания!»
cases.translation: As Jesus was going out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, "Teacher, look, what stones, what buildings!"
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of) takes the genitive → храма.

cases.sentence: И каждому ___ дает особое поручение, а привратнику наказывает бодрствовать.
cases.translation: And he gives each servant a specific task, and commands the doorkeeper to keep watch.
cases.explain: Дать кому-то (to give to someone) takes the dative → слуге.

cases.sentence: Он пошлет ___ и соберет своих избранных с четырех сторон света.
cases.translation: He will send his angels and gather his chosen ones from the four winds.
cases.explain: Ангелов is the direct object of пошлет (will send); animate plural nouns take a genitive-like accusative ending.

cases.sentence: И тогда люди увидят Сына Человеческого, идущего на облаках с великой ___ и славой.
cases.translation: Then people will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
cases.explain: С (with) describing an accompanying quality takes the instrumental → силой.

cases.sentence: Вас будут отдавать под суд и избивать в ___.
cases.translation: You will be handed over to councils and beaten in synagogues.
cases.explain: В (in) marking a static location takes the prepositional → синагогах.

reading.ru: «Здесь не останется и камня на камне, все будет разрушено».
reading.question: What did Jesus say would happen to the temple's buildings?
options: Not one stone would be left on another; all would be thrown down
They would be rebuilt with gold
reading.correct: Not one stone would be left on another; all would be thrown down
reading.explain: Jesus said not one stone would be left on another; everything would be torn down.

reading.ru: «Скажи нам, когда это произойдет, и какое знамение укажет на то, что все это скоро исполнится?»
reading.question: What did Peter, James, John and Andrew ask Jesus privately?
options: When these things would happen and what sign would show it was near
Where they should build a new temple
How many disciples would remain faithful
reading.correct: When these things would happen and what sign would show it was near
reading.explain: They asked Jesus when these things would happen and what sign would signal their fulfillment.

reading.ru: Многие будут приходить под Моим именем, говоря, «Это Я», и многих обманут.
reading.question: What warning does Jesus give about people coming in his name?
options: Many will come claiming to be him and will deceive many
No one will ever claim his name
Only priests will use his name
reading.correct: Many will come claiming to be him and will deceive many
reading.explain: Jesus warns that many will come in his name, claiming "I am he," and will deceive many.

reading.ru: Но прежде радостная весть должна быть возвещена всем народом.
reading.question: What must happen before the end comes, according to Jesus?
options: The good news must be preached to all nations
reading.correct: The good news must be preached to all nations
reading.explain: Jesus says the good news must first be proclaimed to all nations.

reading.ru: Говорите то, что вам будет дано в тот час, ведь это не вы сами будете говорить, а Святой Дух.
reading.question: What does Jesus say will happen when the disciples are put on trial?
options: The Holy Spirit will give them what to say
They will be given a lawyer
reading.correct: The Holy Spirit will give them what to say
reading.explain: Jesus tells them not to worry beforehand, for the Holy Spirit will give them the words to speak.

reading.ru: Звезды будут падать с неба, и небесные силы поколеблются.
reading.question: What cosmic signs does Jesus describe happening after the distress of those days?
options: Stars will fall from the sky and the heavenly powers will be shaken
The sea will dry up completely
The mountains will turn to gold
The moon will turn to blood
reading.correct: Stars will fall from the sky and the heavenly powers will be shaken
reading.explain: Jesus describes stars falling from the sky and the heavenly powers being shaken.

reading.ru: Но о том дне или часе не знает никто, кроме Отца. Ни ангелы на небесах, ни Сын.
reading.question: Who does Jesus say knows the day or hour of his return?
options: The angels and the Son together
reading.explain: Jesus says no one knows that day or hour, not even the angels or the Son, but only the Father.

reading.ru: Пусть же он, даже придя внезапно, не застанет вас спящими.
reading.question: What does Jesus warn about the master's sudden return?
options: He should not find them sleeping
He will bring gifts for everyone
He will punish only the doorkeeper
He will delay his return for years
reading.correct: He should not find them sleeping
reading.explain: Jesus warns that the master, coming suddenly, should not find the servants sleeping.
